replay_method: Re-derive the forced successor directly from set identities, source-list color masks and connectivity. Treat the primary result only as the object being checked, not as an assumption.

source_list_repartition: Under the enlarged seed, source-list size is four minus the number of distinct seed-neighbor colors.
Z0 is impossible in any extension because all four colors occur on seed neighbors.
A Z1 vertex has exactly one color not blocked by seed neighbors, so every extension must use that color.
If the forced Z1 coloring conflicts with an already fixed vertex or another Z1 vertex, no extension exists.
Otherwise moving Z1 to X0 and assigning Z2/Z3/Z4 to X/Y/Y0 gives axiom (v) by definition.
Because every Z1 has a seed neighbor, moving it to X0 does not alter the residual Z4 set.
vi_mask_replay: Old X has two distinct seed colors and cannot become a 3-list Y after seed enlargement.
Old Y0 has zero old seed colors and single/equal-color forcing adds at most one distinct color; any old-Y0 vertex becoming 3-list Y lies in a whole removed old component and cannot see retained Y0.
Therefore every residual-adjacent new Y comes from old Y.
If an old Y remains 3-list, its new one-color seed mask contains its old one-color mask and therefore equals it.
The old axiom-(vi) controlling color is unchanged.
singleton_origin: A Z1 source singleton after one/equal-color forcing cannot originate in old Y: source-list size 3 can fall by at most one.
It cannot originate in old Y0: zero old seed colors plus one distinct forced color leaves source-list size at least 3.
Hence every Z1 vertex is an old X vertex.
connectivity_repair: After Z1 is moved to X0, every component of G minus X0_plus not containing the seed lies in residual Y0, because every non-Y0 nonfixed vertex has a seed neighbor.
Old G minus old X0 was connected, so a newly separated component C has a neighbor x in Z1.
x was old X. Old axiom (iv) applied to the connected old-Y0 component containing C makes x complete to C once x has one neighbor there.
Thus the color of x is globally forbidden on C.
C has no nonfixed outside neighbors because it is a component of G minus X0_plus. All remaining outside constraints come from fixed X0_plus neighbors.
Exact lists on C are therefore subsets of one common three-color palette, and constructive P7-free List-3 is sufficient.
Colorable C can be deleted with a stored reconstruction witness; uncolorable C makes the whole forced state UNSAT.
After all such deletions, G minus X0_plus is connected and axioms (ii)-(vi) remain true.
B0_inheritance: Any new residual-adjacent 3-list Y is an old Y with the same source 3-list.
Hence any new competing survivor was already an old competing survivor of the same list class.
Old B0 source-Z membership is inherited; current component uniformity follows again from axiom (iv).
Residual components only disappear, so no new survivor-to-component incidence on a newly created component is introduced.
component_stack_reentry: The repaired nonterminal state has a nonempty seed and satisfies axioms (i), (iii), (iv).
If a residual component had no dynamic complete neighbor, it would be a component of G minus X0 disjoint from the seed, contradicting axiom (i).
Therefore every remaining residual component is coupled and C0 applies.
C0 recompiles messages from the enlarged fixed-X0 base lists; C2 rebuilds the induced-path-safe dynamic/component quotient; C3 rebuilds selector gadgets and reconstruction pointers.
progress: Single forcing moves at least one previously unprecolored vertex to S; pair forcing moves two.
Z1 promotion moves additional vertices to X0 and connectivity repair only deletes vertices.
The authorized successor relation never moves a vertex out of S or X0 and never restores a deleted component.
Hence M strictly decreases by at least one per forced successor.
There are at most 4n single-color queries and 4*binom(n,2) equal-color pair queries, so immediate forced successors are O(n^2).
recursion_firewall: Depth at most n plus polynomial immediate fanout is not a polynomial total-state proof.
No quotient on different forced subsets/color assignments has yet been proved.
Therefore R1/R2 decidability and recursive reseeding remain open.
